_notes: Source of truth for ratings is Google Business Profile. Skill 3 reads brand.gbp_rating_value and brand.gbp_review_count from plan-input.json's brand block (populated by Skill 2 from DataForSEO business_data_business_listings_search).
Emit only when both fields are populated. Empty/null fields → omit the entire AggregateRating block (do NOT emit a 0-rating block; that hurts trust signals).
Embed AggregateRating INSIDE the LocalBusiness/Organization block on the home and about pages — NOT as a standalone top-level schema. Google ignores orphaned AggregateRating blocks.
Refresh policy: re-fetch GBP rating quarterly (or whenever the build runs after >90 days). Pin the value to the build for determinism.
